process_area.title: Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Inventory Planning, DC Ops (links to VS-04), Category (links to VS-01)
fields.Volume: ~2,000–8,000 active SKUs per dark store (curated for catchment)

workflows.name: Dark Store Inventory Positioning, Safety Stock & Replenishment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates replenishment transfer requests to feeder DC when min breached" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Dark Store Ops Mgr reviews slow-movers" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
- operational: velocity-based safety stock and same-day DC replenishment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stockout risk**: Dark store stockouts cause substitute/short-ship and lost sale; mitigated by velocity-based safety stock and same-day DC replenishment
System Touchpoints: - Inventory/safety stock engine (links to VS-05); inter-site transfer (links to VS-04/VS-05); cycle count

steps.activity: Inventory Planning sets per-SKU safety stock and reorder point for the dark store based on catchment velocity, lead time from feeder DC (links to VS-04), and target service level (98%+); distinguishes A/B/C velocity
System auto-generates replenishment transfer requests to feeder DC when min breached; DC schedules transfer (links to VS-05/VS-04); inbound received and putaway to forward pick faces

Dark Store Ops Mgr reviews slow-movers (links to VS-05 aging) and obsolete candidates; returns to DC or removes from dark-store range (links to W3110); confirms physical-to-book accuracy via cycle count

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Industrial Engineer, Pickers
fields.Trigger: Monthly slotting review; seasonal/sale velocity shift

workflows.name: Dark Store Slotting, Velocity Analysis & Re-Slotting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-assign of "execute re-slot during low-volume window" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
- operational: overnight execution and phased moves
Pain Points / Risks: - **Re-slot disruption risk**: Re-slot during peak hurts throughput; mitigated by overnight execution and phased moves
System Touchpoints: - WMS slotting module; velocity analytics (links to PA-93.3/VS-28)

steps.activity: Industrial Engineer computes SKU velocity (lines/day, picks/day) and current slot location; identifies A-velocity SKUs in non-golden-zone slots and C-velocity SKUs consuming golden-zone space
Engineer proposes re-slot plan: A-velocity → eye-level/golden zone nearest pack stations; C-velocity → reserve/upper; bundle/kit components co-located; automation (MFC) bins re-balanced
Picker execute re-slot during low-volume window (overnight/early AM); WMS updates bin assignments; productivity uplift measured post-implementation vs. baseline lines/picker-hour (links to W3107)

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Network Planning, Finance, HR, BI (links to VS-28)

workflows.name: Dark Store Throughput, Utilization & Labor Productivity Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-dispatch of "dispatch on-time %, automation utilization %, labor utilization vs." (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag for investigation of "investigates root causes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate against labor-cost-per-order target" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
- operational: accuracy-weighted incentive and quality audit (links to W3099)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gaming risk**: Pickers inflate scans or skip quality for productivity bonus; mitigated by accuracy-weighted incentive and quality audit (links to W3099)
System Touchpoints: - BI dashboards (links to VS-28); WMS/LMS productivity data; HR T&A (links to VS-19)

steps.activity: BI (links to VS-28) computes dark-store throughput KPIs: orders/hour, lines/picker-hour, orders/pack-station-hour, dispatch on-time %, automation utilization %, labor utilization vs. plan
Dark Store Ops Mgr benchmarks dark stores vs. each other and vs. external benchmark; identifies laggards; investigates root causes (staffing, layout, automation downtime, demand mix)
HR/Finance model productivity-linked incentive, shift design, and overtime to lift utilization; validate against labor-cost-per-order target

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Ecommerce Ops (links to VS-60), CS (links to VS-13), BI

workflows.name: Dark Store Order Cycle Time, Cut-Off Adherence & SLA Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-dispatch of "dispatch → delivery/handover" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports cut-off adherence" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden SLA miss**: Last-mile carrier delay wrongly attributed to dark store; mitigated by segmenting internal vs. external SLA
System Touchpoints: - OMS/WMS event stream (links to VS-60); CS ticketing (links to VS-13); BI (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: System tracks end-to-end order cycle time: order received → wave release → pick complete → pack complete → dispatch → delivery/handover; segments by promise tier (same-day, next-day, BOPIS)
Dark Store Ops Mgr reports cut-off adherence (orders accepted before cut-off delivered same-day %), promise-breach rate, and breach root-cause (pick delay, pack delay, dispatch delay, carrier delay)
Ecommerce Ops/CS (links to VS-13/VS-60) consolidate customer-facing SLA report; feed into dark-store scorecard and capex/expansion trigger (links to W3095)

fields.Participants: Quality, Finance, CS (links to VS-13), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23)

workflows.name: Dark Store Pick/Pack Accuracy, Damages & Cost-per-Order

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compiles pick accuracy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "scanner calibration, fraud-control" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-77 (ensure dark-store order accuracy & dispatch control.)
- operational: automation bolt-on (links to W3095) and productivity program
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-per-order drift**: Labor inflation and consumable cost erode economics; mitigated by automation bolt-on (links to W3095) and productivity program
System Touchpoints: - Quality/AQL data; finance cost model (links to VS-17); LP shrink (links to VS-23)

steps.activity: Quality compiles pick accuracy (mis-picks per 10,000), pack accuracy (wrong-item/quantity per 10,000), damage-in-transit %, and customer-reported error rate; correlates to picker/packer IDs

Finance computes fully-loaded cost-per-order: labor + consumables + automation depreciation + real estate + utilities + last-mile cost + returns cost; benchmarks vs. ship-from-store (links to VS-10) and DC (links to VS-04) baselines
Dark Store Ops Mgr/LP (links to VS-23) investigate accuracy outliers and shrink; implement corrective action (training, re-slot, scanner calibration, fraud-control) and track to closure

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Category Mgmt (links to VS-01), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), BI
fields.Trigger: Monthly ranging review; new-product introduction; slow-mover purge

workflows.name: Dark Store Demand Sensing & Dynamic SKU Ranging

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update ecommerce availability flag" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
- operational: one-in-one-out rule and monthly purge
Pain Points / Risks: - **Range bloat**: Adding SKUs without retiring slow-movers hurts productivity; mitigated by one-in-one-out rule and monthly purge
System Touchpoints: - Demand sensing (links to VS-28/VS-02); ranging master (links to VS-01); ecommerce availability (links to VS-10)

steps.activity: BI/Category (links to VS-28/VS-01) sense demand signals: trending SKUs (search/add-to-cart without order), local events (construction projects, typhoon rebuild — links to VS-69), seasonality, and competitor gaps
Category (links to VS-01) proposes range adds (high-signal new SKUs) and range drops (slow-movers with < N lines/month); validate vs. dark-store pick-face capacity and feeder-DC availability
Dark Store Ops Mgr executes range change: inbound new SKUs from DC, slot to golden zone (links to W3106), update ecommerce availability flag (links to VS-10); remove slow-movers via W3105

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, CS (links to VS-13), CX/Insights (links to VS-44), BI
fields.Trigger: Monthly CX cycle; CS complaint spike

workflows.name: Dark Store Service Level & Customer Experience Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure dark-store-served customer satisfaction" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracked to closure" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution error**: CX issues from last-mile carrier wrongly credited to dark store; mitigated by segmented scorecard
System Touchpoints: - CS/CX platforms (links to VS-13/VS-44); BI dashboards (links to VS-28); OMS routing (links to VS-60)

steps.activity: CX/CS (links to VS-44/VS-13) measure dark-store-served customer satisfaction: on-time delivery %, order accuracy %, CSAT/NPS, complaint themes (late, wrong item, damaged, missing), refund rate
Dark Store Ops Mgr prioritizes top complaint themes; root-causes to specific dark store / picker / packer / carrier; corrective action tracked to closure
Ecommerce/CX publish dark-store CX scorecard vs. ship-from-store (links to VS-10); informs OMS routing preference (links to VS-60) and capex/expansion (links to W3095)

fields.Participants: Dark Store Ops Mgr, Sustainability Lead (links to VS-25), Facilities, Procurement (links to VS-34)
fields.Trigger: Annual sustainability review; ESG reporting cycle (links to VS-25)

workflows.name: Dark Store Sustainability, Energy & Waste Optimization

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "Dark Store Ops Mgr/Procurement execute reduction initiatives" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports dark-store emissions and waste into Scope 1/2/3 inventory" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-510 (ensure controlled execution — Dark Store Inventory, Capacity & Performance Analytics (PA-93.3).)
- operational: recyclable-first procurement and waste tracking (links to VS-73)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Packaging-waste regulation risk**: Philippine plastic/extended-producer-responsibility law evolving; mitigated by recyclable-first procurement and waste tracking (links to VS-73)
System Touchpoints: - Energy metering (links to VS-25 W692); packaging materials master; ESG scorecard (links to VS-25); carrier CO₂ (links to VS-56)

steps.activity: Sustainability Lead (links to VS-25) measures dark-store footprint: energy (kWh/order — automation, lighting, HVAC), packaging waste (carton, void-fill, tape per order), and last-mile CO₂; benchmarks vs. ship-from-store

Dark Store Ops Mgr/Procurement execute reduction initiatives: right-box cartonization (reduces void-fill), recyclable/compostable packaging, motion-sensor LED, automation energy saver, route consolidation (links to VS-06/VS-56)

Sustainability Lead reports dark-store emissions and waste into Scope 1/2/3 inventory (links to VS-25 W192); supports retailer ESG disclosure and any packaging-extended-producer-responsibility (EPR) obligation
